biotools.summary: NucleoSeeker is a tool for curating high-quality RNA datasets from the Protein Data Bank (PDB). It offers multiple filters and streamlines the data curation process, facilitating the creation of tailored datasets for tasks like training and evaluating RNA structure prediction models.
